response.overview: They Will Live Out Their Most Secret Fantasies  Clémence (Clémence Audiard) and Matthew (Matthew Meier) have been a couple for several years, and everything seems to be going well for them. Yet, for some time now, she has noticed that her husband is spending more and more time on social media admiring gorgeous women who often pose in lingerie or simply in revealing outfits that leave little of their dream bodies to the imagination. Far from being jealous, Clémence confesses one of her latest fantasies to him: she wants him to make love to another woman in front of her while she watches. She does not want to lose him and prefers to take the initiative before their relationship starts to fall apart. A few days later, after carefully browsing all the specialized websites and apps, Clémence invites Candee (Candee Licious), a stunning blonde, to join them. The rest of the night only confirms that she made the right choice and, above all, that this may not be their last night as a threesome…
response.title: Luxure: My Wife's Dates
